name: Battle Royale
description: The shooter kit dropped into a closing arena: commit to a landing, loot under time pressure, rotate with the zone, and be the last squad standing. The pack reuses the entire Shooter fire pipeline and adds the match-scoped machinery — progression.match_lifecycle sequences lobby to podium, world.zone_collapse supplies the clock, combat.downed_revive makes squadmates worth saving, and presentation.spectator_mode keeps the dead in their seats.
loop: drop → loot → zone shrinks → last one standing

signatureCompound.name: Last Squad Standing
signatureCompound.description: A full compressed match: deploy from the drop path, loot and fight inside a multi-phase zone collapse, down-and-revive through the mid-game, and resolve to a podium through the lifecycle state machine. Proves the match has a beginning, a middle, and an end — not just a shrinking circle.
